title: Stay-in-Touch Reminder for Loved Ones
dataSources: Relationship check-ins (`relationship:checkin`), date nights (`datenight:log`), gift ideas (`giftidea:item`), keep-in-touch contacts (`keptintouch:contact`).
app: Relationship and togetherness logs — shared check-in apps, date-night and gift-idea lists, and stay-in-touch reminders — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=keptintouch:contact
| stats latest(_time) as last_contact, latest(target_days) as cadence by person
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_contact)/86400,0), overdue=if(days_since>cadence,1,0)
| where overdue=1
| sort - days_since
description: Reminds you which friends and family you have not spoken to within the cadence you set for each of them.
value: Meaningful relationships fade through simple neglect; a per-person reminder keeps the important ones warm.
implementation: Log calls and messages into `index=personal`; alert when a loved one is overdue for contact.
visualization: Table of people overdue for a catch-up.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds you which friends and family you have not been in touch with for a while, so no one slips away.
